query:
MATCH p = ALL TRAIL (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: The caller has selected its temporary graph and binds $seed as STRING. ALL TRAIL keeps all 1-to-3-hop outgoing follow paths, allows repeated nodes, and forbids repeated edges. Plain RETURN preserves duplicate business-id lists arising from parallel edges; transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) preserves path node order. References: documented-syntax.md MATCH path_search_prefix; patterns.md Path Patterns; documented-functions.md nodes() and transform(); functions.md Lambda Expressions; identifiers.md. The bundled quote-identifiers helper confirmed every generated identifier is an ordinary legal identifier. No database execution performed.
